Following the rescue of [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Ketrian Altronel]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] captivity, Makintay undertook an unauthorized '''mission''' to [[Hargeeva]]. Altronel, as a [[Class A Security Risk]], had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] with [[Xebonica]] as per standard protocol, but was not responding to a treatment of [[Trypanid]]. Makintay, along with [[Merinda Niemeh]], intended to capture Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]] in an effort to find a cure.
